name: id
description: abstractNumId (w:abstractNumId, unique within /numbering). Omit for auto-assignment. Renaming after Add would orphan every <w:num> referencing it; not supported.

name: type
description: multiLevelType (w:multiLevelType). Default: hybridMultilevel. Hybrid is what Word writes for ad-hoc lists; singleLevel locks bullets/numbers to level 0.

name: name
description: human-readable name (w:name). Optional; Word shows this in the Numbering dialog.

name: styleLink
description: back-reference to a numbering style (w:styleLink). Optional.

name: numStyleLink
description: link to another abstractNum via numbering style (w:numStyleLink). Optional.

name: format
description: numFmt for level 0 (and propagated to all 9 levels if no per-level override). Common values: decimal, decimalZero, upperRoman, lowerRoman, upperLetter, lowerLetter, ordinal, cardinalText, ordinalText, bullet, chineseCounting, chineseLegalSimplified, japaneseCounting, koreanCounting, hex. Script-localized formats: arabicAlpha (أ ب ت ث), arabicAbjad (أ ب ج د), hebrew1, hebrew2, hindiNumbers, hindiVowels, hindiCounting, hindiConsonants, thaiCounting, thaiNumbers, thaiLetters. Top-level bare 'format' is shorthand for level0.format; setting it also defaults every other level to the same format instead of the decimal/lowerLetter/lowerRoman cycle.

name: text
description: lvlText for level 0. Use %N as placeholder for level N's running counter (e.g. '%1.', '%1.%2', '第%1章'). Bullet marker default: •. Top-level bare 'text' is shorthand for level0.text.

name: start
description: starting number for level 0. Default 1. Shorthand for level0.start.

name: indent
description: left indent in twips for level 0. Default (level+1)*720. Shorthand for level0.indent.

name: level<N>.format
description: numFmt for level N (N = 0..8). Same vocabulary as bare 'format'. Per-level override; only set the levels you actually use, the rest fall back to decimal/lowerLetter/lowerRoman cycle (or whatever 'format' propagates).

name: level<N>.text
description: lvlText for level N. Same %N placeholder syntax.

name: level<N>.start
description: starting number for level N.

name: level<N>.indent
description: left indent in twips for level N.

name: level<N>.hanging
description: hanging indent in twips for level N. Default 360.

name: level<N>.justification
description: lvlJc — marker alignment within the indent area. Default left.

name: level<N>.suff
description: what comes between the marker and the text content. Default tab.

name: level<N>.font
description: marker font (rPr/rFonts on the level). Useful for bullet glyphs that need Symbol or Wingdings.

name: level<N>.size
description: marker font size (rPr/sz on the level). Bare number = pt.

name: level<N>.color
description: marker color (rPr/color on the level).

name: level<N>.bold
description: bold marker.

name: level<N>.italic
description: italic marker.

name: abstractNumId
description: readback alias for id (matches the w:abstractNumId attribute name).

name: name
description: bookmark name (required). Letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' only.

name: text
description: optional bookmark-covered text. Without this, only an empty Start/End pair is inserted.

name: id
description: OOXML bookmark id (w:bookmarkStart/@w:id). Assigned by the writer; surfaces only on Get/Query.

name: id
description: the bookmark id to close (w:bookmarkEnd/@w:id) — must match the w:id of the bookmarkStart being closed. Required unless `name` is given.

name: name
description: resolve the id from an existing bookmarkStart of this name (the last unclosed same-name start, else the last named start). Convenience alternative to id; ignored when id is supplied.

name: dispUnits
description: value-axis display units token readback (e.g. thousands, millions). Surfaces on the chart node when emitted by the value axis.

name: seriesCount
description: number of data series in the chart (extended cx:chart only).

name: radarstyle
description: radar chart subtype. Values: standard|line, marker, filled|fill.

name: roundedcorners
description: round the chart-area outer corners.

name: valaxisvisible
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] visible (on role=value); see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: areafill
description: fill applied to every series shape. Solid color or gradient 'c1-c2[:angle]'.

name: autotitledeleted
description: suppress the auto-generated 'Chart Title' placeholder.

name: axisfont
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] axisFont; see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: axisline
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] lineWidth/lineDash; see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: axismax
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] max (on value/value2); see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: axismin
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] min (on value/value2); see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: axisnumfmt
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] axisNumFmt / format; see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: axisorientation
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] axisOrientation; see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: axisposition
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] tickLabelPos / crossBetween; see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: axistitle
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] title (value-axis); see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: axisvisible
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] visible; see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: bubbleScale
description: bubble chart scale (% of default).

name: catAxisVisible
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] visible (on role=category); see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: catTitle
description: category axis title text.

name: cataxisline
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] lineWidth/lineDash (on role=category); see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: categories
description: comma-separated category labels, OR a cell range reference (e.g. Sheet1!A2:A5)

name: chartFill
description: chart-level fill color (accepts #RRGGBB, named colors, or scheme names).

name: chartType
description: normalized chartType string without modifiers (modifiers surface as separate flags in later iterations)

name: chartareafill
description: chart-area background fill. Solid color, gradient, or 'none'.

name: chartborder
description: chart-area outer border line. Same format as plotborder.

name: colorrule
description: conditional per-data-point color. Format: 'threshold:belowColor:aboveColor'.

name: colors
description: comma-separated series fill colors, positional (1st color → series 1). Per-series dotted keys (series1.color=...) override positions.

name: combosplit
description: combo chart split index: first N series use primary chart type, rest use secondary. Add-time only.

name: combotypes
description: rebuild as combo chart with per-series chart types (column,line,area,...). Comma-separated, one per series.

name: crossBetween
description: category axis cross-between behavior (between / midCat).

name: crosses
description: where the value axis crosses the category axis. Values: autoZero (default), max, min.

name: crossesAt
description: value-axis crossesAt value readback.

name: data
description: inline series spec 'Name:1,2,3' or 'Name1:1,2,3;Name2:4,5,6'. Add-time only; use per-series chart-series Set after creation.

name: dataLabels
description: show/hide data labels. Use 'none' to hide; otherwise comma list of flags: value, percent, category, series, all (also accepts seriesName/categoryName/percentage/values aliases). Position values (outsideEnd/center/insideEnd/insideBase/top/bottom/left/right/bestFit) implicitly enable showVal and apply as dLblPos.

name: dataTable
description: show data table beneath the chart (with default borders + legend keys).

name: decreaseColor
description: waterfall: negative bar color. Add-time only.

name: dispBlanksAs
description: how empty cells render (gap leaves a hole, zero plots as 0, span connects across).

name: droplines
description: drop lines on line chart. true|false toggle or line spec 'color[:width[:dash]]'; 'none' removes.

name: errbars
description: error bars on each series. Format: 'type:value' where type ∈ fixed (alias: fixedValue), percent (alias: percentage, pct), stddev (alias: standardDeviation), stderr (alias: standardError). 'none' removes.

name: explosion
description: pie/doughnut slice explosion 0..100 (percent of radius); 0 removes.

name: firstSliceAngle
description: pie/doughnut first slice angle (degrees).

name: gapdepth
description: depth gap between series in 3D bar/line/area charts (percent).

name: gapwidth
description: gap between bar/column groups, 0..500 (percent of bar width).

name: gradient
description: gradient fill applied to every series. Format: 'c1-c2[-c3][:angle]' (angle in degrees). Errors if chart has no series.

name: gradients
description: per-series gradient fills, semicolon-separated; one entry per series.

name: gridlines
description: value-axis major gridlines. true|false toggle, or line spec 'color', 'color:width', 'color:width:dash' to style; 'none' removes.

name: height
description: chart frame height; accepts cm/in/pt/EMU. Ignored if anchor= is set.

name: hilowlines
description: high-low lines on line/stock chart. Same format as droplines.

name: holeSize
description: doughnut hole size readback.

name: increaseColor
description: waterfall: positive bar color. Add-time only.

name: invertifneg
description: if true, draw negative bars in an inverted (lighter) color.

name: labelPos
description: data label position. Values: center|ctr, insideEnd|inEnd|inside, insideBase|inBase|base, outsideEnd|outEnd|outside, bestFit|best|auto, top|t, bottom|b, left|l, right|r. Restrictions: not supported on doughnut/area/radar/stock; pie/pie3D restricted to ctr/inEnd/inBase/bestFit (other tokens rejected, per OOXML ST_DLblPosPie); stacked series clamp to ctr/inBase/inEnd; combo charts skip entirely.

name: labelfont
description: data label text font. Format: 'size:color:fontname' (any segment optional). Readback is split into labelFont.size / labelFont.color / labelFont.bold / labelFont.name (one key per slot) so dump→replay can rebuild the compound spec without parsing.

name: labelFont.size
description: data label font size in points. Readback of the size slot inside labelfont= (BuildLabelTextProperties' DefaultRunProperties.FontSize).

name: labelFont.color
description: data label font color (hex, e.g. #FF0000). Readback of the color slot inside labelfont=.

name: labelFont.bold
description: data label font bold flag. Emitted only when true.

name: labelFont.name
description: data label font typeface (latin). Readback of the fontname slot inside labelfont=.

name: labeloffset
description: category-axis label offset 0..1000 (percent of font height); category axis only.

name: labelrotation
description: tick-label rotation in degrees (-90..90). Bare 'labelrotation' targets both axes; xaxis.* targets category, yaxis./valaxis.* targets value.

name: leaderlines
description: show/hide leader lines connecting data labels to slices (pie/doughnut).

name: legend
description: legend position. 'none'/'false' hides; otherwise place at top|t, bottom|b, left|l, right|r, topRight|tr. Hyphen and underscore variants accepted.

name: legend.overlay
description: if true, legend overlays the plot area instead of reserving space.

name: legendFont
description: legend text font. Format: 'size:color:fontname' (any segment optional).

name: linedash
description: line dash style for every series. Values: solid, dash, dashDot, dot, lgDash, lgDashDot, sysDash, sysDot, sysDashDot.

name: linewidth
description: line width in points (applies to every series line).

name: logbase
description: value-axis logarithmic base (2..1000 typically). Shorthand: true|yes|log|1 → base 10; false|none|linear|0 removes log scale.

name: majorTickMark
description: major tick mark style (out / in / cross / none).

name: majorunit
description: value-axis major gridline / tick spacing.

name: marker
description: marker symbol for line/scatter/radar series only (other types silently skipped). Format: 'symbol' or 'symbol:size' or 'symbol:size:color'. Symbols: none, auto, circle, square, diamond, triangle, x, plus, star, dash, dot. (picture markers are not implemented.) Chart-level Get surfaces a first-series representative value once any series carries a marker (the dump emitter relies on it for uniform-marker charts); the authoritative per-series read is /chart[N]/series[K] (chart-series schema declares marker get:true).

name: markersize
description: marker size 2..72 (line/scatter/radar series only).

name: markercolor
description: marker fill color (line/scatter/radar series only). Fans out to every applicable series; preserves existing marker symbol/size. Read back from the first series' marker spPr/solidFill.

name: minorGridlines
description: value-axis minor gridlines; same format as gridlines.

name: minorTickMark
description: minor tick mark style (out / in / cross / none).

name: minorunit
description: value-axis minor gridline / tick spacing.

name: overlap
description: bar/column overlap within a group, -100..100 (negative = gap, positive = overlap).

name: plotFill
description: plot-area background fill. Solid color, gradient 'c1-c2[:angle]', or 'none'.

name: plotborder
description: plot-area border line. Format: 'color', 'color:width', 'color:width:dash'; or 'none'.

name: plotvisonly
description: if true, skip plotting hidden worksheet rows/columns.

name: preset
description: named style bundle. Values: minimal, dark, corporate, magazine, dashboard, colorful, monochrome (alias mono).

name: referenceline
description: horizontal reference / target line. Format: 'value' or 'value:color' or 'value:color:label' or 'value:color:label:dash'. Pass 'none' to remove.

name: scatterstyle
description: scatter chart subtype. Values: line|lineOnly, lineMarker, marker|markerOnly, smooth|smoothLine, smoothMarker.

name: secondaryaxis
description: comma-separated 1-based series indices to plot on a secondary value axis.

name: series{N}
description: legacy bare per-series data update (N is the 1-based series index). 'series{N}="1,2,3"' replaces the numeric values for series N; 'series{N}="Name:1,2,3"' also updates the series label. Prefer the dotted form (series{N}.name=, series{N}.values=) for clarity — see chart-series schema.

name: seriesoutline
description: series outline. Format: 'color', 'color:width', or 'color:width:dash' (also accepts '-' separator); 'none' removes.

name: seriesshadow
description: outer shadow on every series shape. Format: 'COLOR-BLUR-ANGLE-DIST-OPACITY'; 'none' removes.

name: serlines
description: series lines on stacked bar charts (true/false).

name: shape
description: 3D bar shape. Values: box|cuboid, cone, coneToMax, cylinder, pyramid, pyramidToMax. Bar3D charts only.

name: showMarker
description: show markers on line/scatter series at chart level (true|false).

name: shownegbubbles
description: render negative-valued bubbles. Bubble charts only.

name: sizerepresents
description: how bubble size value is mapped. Values: area (default), width|w. Bubble charts only.

name: smooth
description: smooth lines on line/scatter charts (true|false). Reported unsupported for other chart types.

name: style
description: built-in chart style id 1..48; pass 'none' to clear.

name: tickLabelPos
description: tick label position (high / low / nextTo / none).

name: ticklabelskip
description: draw tick labels every Nth category (category axis).

name: title
description: chart title text; pass 'none' (case-insensitive) or an empty string to omit/remove the title — on add this skips creating the title element, on set it removes an existing title. Get also returns sub-keys title.font, title.size, title.color, title.bold when set; these are get-only readback fields surfaced from chart title runs.

name: title.bold
description: title bold flag (true|false).

name: title.color
description: title font color (#RRGGBB, named, or scheme color).

name: title.font
description: title font name.

name: title.overlay
description: if true, title overlays the plot area instead of reserving space above it.

name: title.size
description: title font size (e.g. 14 or 14pt).

name: totalColor
description: waterfall: subtotal/total bar color. Add-time only.

name: transparency
description: series fill transparency (0..100, percent). 'transparency' is inverse of 'opacity'/'alpha' (transparency=30 ≡ opacity=70).

name: trendline
description: add trendline to every series. Format: 'type[:order]' or 'type:forward:backward'. Types: linear (default), exp|exponential, log|logarithmic, poly|polynomial, power, movingAvg|moving|movingAverage. Order applies to poly/movingAvg. Pass 'none' to clear.

name: updownbars
description: up/down bars on line chart. true | 'gapWidth:upColor:downColor' | 'none'/'false'.

name: valaxisline
description: convenience shortcut for /chart[N]/axis[@role=...] lineWidth/lineDash (on role=value); see chart-axis schema for full axis-level options

name: varyColors
description: vary colors by data point (true|false; single-series charts).

name: view3d
description: 3D view angles. Format: 'rotX,rotY,perspective' (any tail optional) or single integer for perspective only. Named-key form (rotX=...) is rejected.

name: width
description: chart frame width; accepts cm/in/pt/EMU. Ignored if anchor= is set.

name: axisFont
description: axis text font readback.

name: axisMax
description: value-axis maximum readback (also surfaced via max on axis-by-role path).

name: axisMin
description: value-axis minimum readback (also surfaced via min on axis-by-role path).

name: axisNumFmt
description: axis number format string.

name: axisOrientation
description: axis scaling orientation (e.g. maxMin when reversed).

name: axisTitle
description: value-axis title readback (chart-level convenience; axis-by-role uses 'title').

name: format
description: number format string

name: labelOffset
description: category axis label offset (% of default 100).

name: labelRotation
description: tick label rotation in degrees

name: logBase
description: logarithmic base for value axis scale. Only valid for role=value or role=value2; ignored on category axes.

name: majorGridlines
description: show or hide major gridlines. Applies to all roles.

name: max
description: maximum scale of the value axis. Only valid for role=value or role=value2; ignored on category axes.

name: min
description: minimum scale of the value axis. Only valid for role=value or role=value2; ignored on category axes.

name: minorGridlines
description: show or hide minor gridlines. Applies to all roles.

name: tickLabelSkip
description: category axis label skip interval (>1 means tick labels are sparser).

name: title
description: axis title text. Applies to all roles (category, value). Pass 'none' to remove.

name: visible
description: show or hide the axis. Applies to all roles.

name: categories
description: per-series category override; range reference only.

name: categoriesRef
description: A1 cell range backing the category labels.

name: color
description: series fill color.

name: dataLabels.numFmt
description: per-series data label number format readback.

name: dataLabels.separator
description: per-series data label separator string readback.

name: errBars
description: error bar value type (fixed, percent, stddev, stderr); accepted aliases: fixedValue, percentage/pct, standardDeviation, standardError. Pass 'none' to clear. Silently ignored on series types that don't support error bars.

name: invertIfNeg
description: invert color for negative values. Bar/column/area/pie series only; line/scatter silently ignore.

name: lineDash
description: series line dash style. Set accepts user-friendly aliases (dash/dot/dashDot/longDash); Get returns OOXML token (sysDash/sysDot/sysDashDot/lgDash). 'dashDotDot' has no native enum member and is accepted as an alias for sysDashDotDot — Get readback will return sysDashDotDot. 'solid' is the only round-trip-stable value.

name: lineWidth
description: series line width in points (e.g. 1.5).

name: marker
description: per-series marker symbol. Values: circle, dash, diamond, dot, plus, square, star, triangle, x, none, auto. Supports 'symbol:size:COLOR' compound form (e.g. 'circle:8:FF0000'). Applies to line/scatter/radar series. (picture markers are not implemented.)

name: markerSize
description: marker size in points (2–72). Applies when marker is not 'none'.

name: markerColor
description: per-series marker fill color (line/scatter/radar). Preserves existing symbol and size — pair with marker=/markerSize= to set the triplet independently. Round-trips via Reader's spPr/solidFill probe.

name: name
description: series name shown in legend and data labels.

name: nameRef
description: A1 cell reference backing the series name.

name: scatterStyle
description: scatter sub-style (line/lineMarker/marker/smooth/smoothMarker/none).

name: secondaryAxis
description: true when the chart has more than one value axis (this series uses the secondary).

name: smooth
description: smooth line interpolation for line/scatter series (true|false).

name: values
description: comma-separated numbers, OR a cell range reference (Sheet1!B2:B13)

name: bubbleSize
description: bubble chart per-point sizes; comma-separated numbers OR a cell range reference. Defaults to the y-values when omitted.

name: bubbleSizeRef
description: A1 cell range backing bubble per-point sizes. Coexists with bubbleSize (the literal becomes the numCache).

name: id
description: OOXML comment id (w:comment/@w:id). Assigned by the writer; surfaces only on Get/Query.

name: anchoredTo
description: path of the paragraph or run the comment is anchored to (resolved from CommentRangeStart).

name: runStart
description: 1-based run index inside the parent paragraph where the comment range starts. N=0 (default) anchors the comment to paragraph start; N>=1 places <w:commentRangeStart/> immediately after the Nth run so dump→batch round-trip restores intra-paragraph anchor positions.

name: range
description: whether the comment spans a text range (default true: emits <w:commentRangeStart/> + <w:commentRangeEnd/> around the anchor plus a <w:commentReference/> run). Pass range=false for a zero-width / point-anchored comment that carries ONLY <w:commentReference/> — used by dump→batch to preserve reference-only comments without synthesizing a spurious range.

name: parentId
description: w:id of the comment this one replies to. Threads the reply under its parent in Word's review pane via word/commentsExtended.xml (w15:paraIdParent, keyed by the comment paragraphs' w14:paraId). Get returns the parent comment's w:id on replies only.

name: done
description: resolved-state of the comment (Word's 'Resolve'), stored in word/commentsExtended.xml as w15:done. Get returns done=true|false on every comment, so 'query comment[done=false]' lists unresolved comments.

name: date
description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Defaults to DateTime.UtcNow.

name: initials
description: author initials. Defaults to derived from author name when omitted.

name: author
description: Author attribute

name: text
description: comment body. Required.

name: mermaid
description: Mermaid diagram source. Canonical (mirrors equation's 'formula'). Aliases: text, dsl. The first line's header (flowchart TD / sequenceDiagram / ...) selects the diagram kind.

name: src
description: Path to a .mmd file to load the mermaid source from (used when no inline mermaid/text/dsl is given). Consistent with picture 'src' = a file path. Alias: path.

name: width
description: Width of the box the diagram is scaled to fit (cm/in/pt/EMU). Aspect ratio is preserved. May enlarge past the text width. Default: the section text-area width (shrink-only). Mirrors picture/chart 'width'.

name: height
description: Height of the box the diagram is scaled to fit (cm/in/pt/EMU). Aspect ratio is preserved. Default: unbounded (width governs).

name: render
description: How to render. auto (default): use real mermaid.js via a headless browser (Chrome/Chromium/Edge) when available — covers EVERY mermaid type (gantt/pie/class/state/er/…) at full fidelity, embedded as a PNG with the mermaid source stamped into alt-text (regenerable); falls back to the native synthesizer when no browser is present. native: always the built-in editable-shape synthesizer (no browser; supported subset only; fully editable in Word). image: force the browser path (errors if no browser). mermaid.js is fetched once to a local cache (mirror d.officecli.ai, CDN fallback).

name: poster
description: Controls page growth for a long diagram. UNSET (default) = ADAPTIVE: the diagram fits the current page, but if fitting would shrink it below readability it auto-grows the section's page to the diagram's natural size instead (clamped to Word's 22in/55.88cm max; split a very long chart past that). true = always grow the page. false = always fit the current page even if the result is tiny. Ignored when an explicit width/height is given.

name: theme
description: mermaid color theme (image render only): default (light), dark, neutral, forest, base. Baked into the source as frontmatter, so it round-trips in alt-text and a regenerate reproduces it. Ignored by render=native. Uses the ESM mermaid build, loaded from the CDN (a styled diagram currently needs network on render; plain diagrams stay offline-cached).

name: layout
description: flowchart layout engine (image render only): dagre (default, curved edges) or elk (Eclipse Layout Kernel — orthogonal edge routing, tighter layered placement). elk loads the @mermaid-js/layout-elk ESM package from the CDN. Ignored by render=native.

name: look
description: visual style (image render only): classic (default) or handDrawn (sketchy rough.js strokes). Baked into the source frontmatter; round-trips in alt-text. Ignored by render=native.

name: background
description: render background: transparent (default), a #hex, or a CSS color word. Applied at render time (mmdc -b / page background); does not round-trip in alt-text. Values with whitespace/quotes fall back to transparent.

description: author string

name: title
description: title string

name: keywords
description: keywords string

name: description
description: description string

name: lastModifiedBy
description: last-modified author

name: category
description: document category metadata. Emitted only when present.

name: revisionNumber
description: document save counter from docProps/core.xml (cp:revision). Distinct from tracked-change revisions — see `help docx revision`.

name: created
description: creation timestamp (ISO-8601). Emitted only when present.

name: modified
description: last modification timestamp (ISO-8601). Emitted only when present.

name: protection
description: document protection mode.

name: protectionEnforced

name: docGrid.type

name: docGrid.linePitch

name: docGrid.charSpace

name: compatibility.mode

name: docDefaults.font.eastAsia
description: default East Asian font slot.

name: docDefaults.font.hAnsi

name: docDefaults.font.complexScript
description: default complex-script font slot.

description: default font size.

description: default italic flag.

description: default right-to-left flag.

description: default paragraph alignment.

description: default paragraph line spacing.

name: autoSpaceDN

name: kinsoku
description: Japanese kinsoku line breaking rules.

name: overflowPunct

description: embed system fonts.

name: gutterAtTop
description: gutter at top.

name: bookFoldPrinting
description: book fold printing layout.

name: evenAndOddHeaders

Newline semantics: \n is a PARAGRAPH boundary (the text is split into one paragraph per line, each inheriting the same style/props); \v is a soft line break within the paragraph (Shift+Enter). name: id
description: marker id (required). permStart and its matching permEnd share the same id.

name: edGrp
description: editing group allowed in the region (ST_EdGrp).

name: ed

name: colLast
description: last table column (0-based) the permission applies to, for a table-column range.

name: decorative
description: Mark the picture as decorative for accessibility. Stored as an adec:decorative extension under <wp:docPr> (uri {C183D7F6-DF14-4A22-8298-3B9A5F5C6C3B}). Screen readers skip decorative images; Word treats their alt text as absent.

name: crop
description: Crop rectangle in percent (0-100), 1 or 4 comma-separated values (left,top,right,bottom). Stored as <a:srcRect> inside <a:blipFill> (1000ths-of-a-percent). Get emits the canonical 4-value form (e.g. 12,6,18,9); the per-side keys (cropLeft/cropTop/cropRight/cropBottom) are accepted on add/set only.

name: cropLeft
description: Crop from the left edge as percent (0-100). Set/add only — Get folds all sides into the canonical crop key.

name: cropTop
description: Crop from the top edge as percent (0-100). Set/add only — Get folds all sides into the canonical crop key.

name: cropRight
description: Crop from the right edge as percent (0-100). Set/add only — Get folds all sides into the canonical crop key.

name: cropBottom
description: Crop from the bottom edge as percent (0-100). Set/add only — Get folds all sides into the canonical crop key.

name: anchor
description: true to create a floating (anchored) picture instead of inline. Required to enable wrap/hPosition/vPosition/hRelative/vRelative/behindText.

name: wrap
description: text wrapping mode for floating picture (none, square, tight, topandbottom, through). For 'behind text', use wrap=none + behindText=true.

name: behindText
description: true when the picture floats behind text (anchor @behindDoc=1).

name: relativeHeight
description: z-order (stacking) of an anchored/floating picture (anchor @relativeHeight). Higher = nearer the front. Distinct per overlapping float; round-trips the raw OOXML value.

name: effectExtent
description: drawing visual overflow/effect margin (wp:effectExtent) as 4 comma-separated EMU ints: left,top,right,bottom. Word's inline-picture layout height depends on this even when wp:extent is identical, so the dump→batch round-trip restores it byte-for-byte. Round-trip prop — emitted by `dump --format batch`, not by `get`; absent value defaults to 0,0,0,0 (the interactive Add default).

name: hPosition
description: absolute horizontal anchor position (positionH/posOffset). Always pass a unit (cm/in/pt) — a bare number is interpreted as raw EMU (914400 per inch), so hPosition=3 is a 3-EMU offset.

name: vPosition
description: absolute vertical anchor position (positionV/posOffset). Always pass a unit (cm/in/pt) — a bare number is interpreted as raw EMU (914400 per inch), so vPosition=4 is a 4-EMU offset.

name: hRelative
description: horizontal anchor reference frame (e.g. page, margin, column, character).

name: vRelative
description: vertical anchor reference frame (e.g. page, margin, paragraph, line).

name: hAlign
description: relative horizontal alignment keyword for a floating picture (left, center, right, inside, outside) via positionH/align. Overrides hPosition when set.

name: vAlign
description: relative vertical alignment keyword for a floating picture (top, bottom, center, inside, outside) via positionV/align. Overrides vPosition when set.

name: link
description: click-hyperlink target for the image, making it clickable (<a:hlinkClick> on pic:cNvPr). An absolute URL or relative target round-trips as a TargetMode=External relationship; a '#anchor' or bare bookmark name round-trips as an internal anchor.

name: width
description: width (extent.Cx). Always pass a unit (cm/in/pt) — a bare number is interpreted as raw EMU (914400 per inch), so width=5 renders an effectively invisible 5-EMU image.

name: height
description: height (extent.Cy). Always pass a unit (cm/in/pt) — a bare number is interpreted as raw EMU (914400 per inch), so height=5 renders an effectively invisible 5-EMU image.

name: fallback
description: optional PNG fallback for SVG sources. When omitted, a 1x1 transparent PNG is generated.

name: id
description: OOXML shape id; source of the @id in the stable path /picture[@id=ID].

name: alt
description: alternative text (DocProperties.Description). When omitted, no description is written (intentional: an auto-filled filename is worse than none for screen readers). Aliases: alttext, description.

name: contentType
description: OOXML content-type of the embedded image part (e.g. `image/png`, `image/jpeg`). Read from the package part referenced by the BlipFill embed relationship.

name: fileSize
description: embedded image file size in bytes (length of the image part stream).

name: relId
description: relationship id of the embedded image part (rId-style token). Required input for `get --save <path>` binary extraction.

name: src
description: image source (file path, URL, data-URI); accepted on add/set only. Get does NOT surface this key; the embedded relationship id is exposed under a separate Format["relId"] key.

name: align
description: ptab alignment attribute

name: relativeTo
description: ptab relativeTo attribute

name: leader
description: ptab leader attribute

name: type
description: revision type (read-only on the revision node; create with --prop revision.type=… on the host element)

name: text
description: text content for ins / content marker for del (read-only).

name: author
description: Author of the revision. Surfaced on `query revision` nodes and on host elements (run/paragraph/…) that carry an ins/del/*PrChange ancestor. Supply via --prop revision.author=… on the host element to create. **Run host is stricter:** `set <run> --prop revision.author=X` alone is rejected — without an action to attribute, the legacy fallback wrote an empty-snapshot rPrChange (recording no change). Either pair revision.author with a real format prop (`--prop bold=true`), or pass `--prop revision.type=ins|del|moveFrom|moveTo` so the wrap itself is the action. The same strictness applies to bare `revision.type=format` on Run. Non-Run hosts (paragraph/table/row/cell/section) still accept bare attribution and emit an empty-snapshot *PrChange — needed for dump→batch round-trip of table-level markers whose pre-change baseline can't be reconstructed. Also accepted alongside `find` (and `replace` / format / paragraph props) — the find dispatch wraps each match in the matching marker shape and attributes it to this author.

name: date
description: ISO-8601 timestamp (read-only on the revision node). Supply via --prop revision.date=… on the host element to create.

name: id
description: w:id attribute. Stable across save; pair moveFrom/moveTo by reusing the same id. Supply via --prop revision.id=… on the host element.

name: nativePath
description: Path to the underlying w:ins/w:del/w:moveFrom/w:moveTo/w:*PrChange element in document DOM terms (e.g. /body/p[2]/ins[1]). Use it to address the revision via the action native-path form: `set <nativePath> --prop revision.action=accept|reject`. Emitted on `query revision` synthetic nodes only.

name: action
description: Accept / reject verb. Lives in a disjoint namespace from the creation keys above; mixing with revision.type/.author/.date/.id throws. Walks matching elements in reverse document order so /revision[N] paths don't shift mid-batch.

name: paraMarkIns.author
description: Author of a paragraph-mark-only insertion (w:rPr/w:ins inside the paragraph's pPr/rPr — the ¶ mark itself is part of the inserted change, distinct from a run-level w:ins wrapping content). Surfaced on paragraph nodes via get/query; on dump→batch the emitter rewrites it to bare revision.author on the synthetic paragraph + strips revision.type so the bare-attribution path defaults the type to ins.

name: paraMarkIns.date
description: ISO-8601 timestamp companion to paraMarkIns.author.

name: paraMarkIns.id
description: w:id of the paragraph-mark insertion. Get-only companion to paraMarkIns.author/.date.

name: paraMarkDel.author
description: Author of a paragraph-mark deletion (w:rPr/w:del in pPr/rPr — the ¶ join is tracked as a deletion). Deletion counterpart of paraMarkIns.author. Get-only.

name: paraMarkDel.date
description: ISO-8601 timestamp companion to paraMarkDel.author.

name: paraMarkDel.id
description: w:id of the paragraph-mark deletion. Get-only.

name: revision.beforeLost
description: Get-only signal: true when a *PrChange 'before' property snapshot cannot round-trip through dump→batch (the prior-formatting baseline is lost on replay). Lets the batch emitter warn rather than silently drop it.

name: sectPrChange.author
description: Author of a w:sectPrChange on a section (revision.type=format equivalent at section scope; surfaced as a distinct key because the snapshot lives in a different OOXML wrapper than rPrChange/pPrChange).

name: sectPrChange.date
description: ISO-8601 timestamp companion to sectPrChange.author.

name: sectPrChange.id
description: Stable w:id companion to sectPrChange.author; preserved across dump→batch so the marker's identity survives the round-trip.

name: tblPrChange.author
description: Author of a w:tblPrChange on a table (table-properties revision — borders/style/layout snapshot).

name: tblPrChange.date
description: ISO-8601 timestamp companion to tblPrChange.author.

name: trPrChange.author
description: Author of a w:trPrChange on a table row (row-properties revision — row height/header/cantSplit snapshot). Separate from w:trPr/w:ins (= row insertion as tracked change).

name: trPrChange.date
description: ISO-8601 timestamp companion to trPrChange.author.

name: tcPrChange.author
description: Author of a w:tcPrChange on a table cell (cell-properties revision — borders/shading/width snapshot). Separate from w:tcPr/w:cellIns/w:cellDel (= cell insertion/deletion).

name: tcPrChange.date
description: ISO-8601 timestamp companion to tcPrChange.author.

description: run reading direction. Use 'rtl' for Arabic / Hebrew, 'ltr' to clear. Canonical key for run direction; matches paragraph/section vocabulary.

name: font.ea
description: East-Asian font slot (rFonts/eastAsia) — Chinese / Japanese / Korean typefaces.

name: font.csTheme
description: Theme font binding for the complex-script slot (rFonts/cstheme). Values: minorBidi, majorBidi.

name: italic.cs

name: size.cs

name: lang.ea
description: EastAsian-script language tag (<w:lang w:eastAsia=.../>). e.g. zh-CN, ja-JP.

name: lang.cs
description: ComplexScript language tag (<w:lang w:bidi=.../>). e.g. ar-SA, he-IL.

name: vertAlign
description: vertical text alignment. Values: superscript|super, subscript|sub, baseline.

name: kern
description: kerning activation threshold (<w:kern w:val=.../>): font sizes at or above this point size get automatic pair kerning. Value is an integer in half-points (28 = 14pt threshold); a 'pt' suffix is NOT accepted (unlike pptx kern). Valid range 0-3277 half-points (~164pt); an empty value clears it.

name: position
description: vertical baseline shift (<w:position w:val=.../>): positive raises text above the baseline, negative lowers it, 0 = baseline. Keeps the full glyph size (distinct from vertAlign=super|sub, which also shrinks the glyph). Accepts a 'pt' value (e.g. 6pt) or a bare integer in half-points; an empty value clears it.

name: pgBorders.zOrder

name: paperSrc.first

name: paperSrc.other
description: printer paper-source bin for the remaining pages of the section (<w:paperSrc w:other>). Integer printer-tray id (0–65535). Companion to paperSrc.first.

name: formProt
description: section form-protection flag (<w:formProt>). When true the section's content is locked except for form fields. Bare on/off toggle; accepts none/off/false to clear. Sits after cols, before vAlign in CT_SectPr order.

name: vAlign
description: vertical alignment of page content (<w:vAlign>). 'center' vertically centers the body; 'both' justifies top-to-bottom. Accepts none/off to clear.

name: textDirection
description: section page text flow direction (<w:textDirection>), East-Asian vertical layout. tbRl is the common vertical (top-to-bottom, columns right-to-left) page flow. Accepts none/off to clear. Distinct from the cell-level textDirection in tcPr.

name: footnotePr.numFmt
description: section footnote number format (<w:footnotePr><w:numFmt>). Restarting footnote numbering per page/section requires footnotePr.numRestart.

description: section footnote numbering restart (<w:footnotePr><w:numRestart>). 'eachPage' restarts the counter on every page; 'eachSect' on every section.

name: endnotePr.pos
description: section endnote placement (<w:endnotePr><w:pos>). sectEnd (section end) or docEnd (document end).

name: geometry
description: preset shape geometry (rect, roundRect, ellipse, triangle, diamond, ...). Aliases: preset.

name: width
description: shape width (cm/in/pt/EMU). Default ~1in.

name: height
description: shape height (cm/in/pt/EMU). Default ~1in.

name: fill

name: line
description: composite outline 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' (or 'none'); split keys line.style/line.width/line.color also accepted.

name: line.color
description: outline color. Alias: linecolor.

name: line.width
description: outline width. Alias: linewidth.

name: line.style
description: outline dash style. Alias: linestyle.

name: alt
description: accessibility / object name (docPr name). Alias: name. Default 'Shape'.

name: id
description: w:styleId (unique, immutable identity). Aliases fall through to 'name' when 'id' is omitted. Renaming after Add would require rewriting every paragraph/run/basedOn reference in the document; not supported.

name: name
description: display name. Defaults to 'id' when omitted.

name: type
description: one of values (innerText of StyleValues)

name: basedOn
description: parent style id to inherit from. Must be an existing w:styleId (not display name). Inherited properties are overridden by properties defined on this style.

name: basedOn.path
description: resolved path to the parent style node (get-only). Shortcut: use basedOn to Set.

name: next
description: next-paragraph style id.

name: linked
description: linked-style pair: a paragraph style references its companion character style (or vice versa). Word UI: 'Linked (paragraph and character)'. Value is the partner styleId; must exist in styles.xml.

name: qFormat
description: mark as a 'primary' (quick) style shown in Word's Styles gallery (<w:qFormat/>). The default Normal style carries this; without round-tripping it the gallery designation is lost.

name: uiPriority
description: sort order of the style in Word's Styles pane / Recommended list (<w:uiPriority>). Lower sorts first.

name: semiHidden
description: hide the style from the main Styles gallery while keeping it usable (<w:semiHidden/>). Usually paired with unhideWhenUsed.

name: unhideWhenUsed

description: one of values

description: highlight color (yellow, green, cyan, magenta, blue, red, darkBlue, darkCyan, darkGreen, darkMagenta, darkRed, darkYellow, darkGray, lightGray, black, white, none).

description: snap to document grid for CJK layout. Applied to the style's pPr. Add/Set only — Get does not surface this back today.

description: allow word-break for non-CJK text inside CJK lines. Applied to the style's pPr. Add/Set only — Get does not surface this back today.

name: autoSpaceDE
description: auto spacing between East-Asian and Latin text. Applied to the style's pPr.

name: autoSpaceDN
description: auto spacing between East-Asian text and numbers. Applied to the style's pPr.

name: bidi
description: right-to-left paragraph direction. Applied to the style's pPr.

name: direction
description: Paragraph reading direction (Arabic / Hebrew). 'rtl' writes <w:bidi/> on the style pPr; equivalent to bidi=true in canonical form.

name: overflowPunct
description: allow punctuation to hang outside the text margin (CJK). Applied to the style's pPr.

name: topLinePunct
description: compress punctuation at the start of a line (CJK). Applied to the style's pPr. Add/Set only — Get does not surface this back today.

name: suppressAutoHyphens
description: disable automatic hyphenation in this style. Add/Set only — Get does not surface this back today.

name: suppressLineNumbers
description: exclude this paragraph style from line numbering. Add/Set only — Get does not surface this back today.

description: force a page break before each paragraph using this style.

name: widowControl
description: prevent widows and orphans (single isolated lines).

description: paragraph border. Sub-keys: pbdr.top / pbdr.bottom / pbdr.left / pbdr.right / pbdr.between / pbdr.bar / pbdr.all. Value form: 'style:size:color' (e.g. 'single:6:#FF0000'). Set-only — Get does not surface paragraph borders on the style today.

name: ilvl
description: list level (0-8) for the style-borne numPr.

name: effective.alignment
description: resolved paragraph alignment after walking basedOn → linked → docDefaults.

description: resolved paragraph reading direction (rtl|ltr).

name: effective.highlight
description: resolved highlight color name (yellow|green|cyan|...) inherited from the style chain.

description: resolved line spacing (`<N>x` or `<N>pt`).

description: resolved space-before (unit-qualified).

description: resolved space-after (unit-qualified).

description: true when strike-through is inherited from the style chain.

description: tab stop position. Accepts twips (bare integer), or a unit-qualified length (6cm / 2in / 360pt). May be negative (OOXML allows a tab stop in the hanging/negative-indent region). Required on add.

name: val
description: tab stop alignment. left/center/right are the everyday values; decimal aligns numbers on the decimal point; bar draws a vertical bar; clear removes an inherited stop; num/start/end are legacy/compat values.

name: leader

description: Reading direction (Arabic / Hebrew). 'rtl' writes <w:bidiVisual/> on tblPr (mirrors column order); 'ltr' clears it. Distinct from per-cell textDirection.

description: table indent in twips.

name: cellSpacing
description: space between cells in twips. Alias: cellspacing.

name: layout
description: one of values

description: default cell padding (all four sides) in twips. Add/Set only — Get does not surface the table-default cell margin today.

description: rows per band when a banded table style applies (<w:tblStyleRowBandSize> @w:val). Default 1; e.g. 2 stripes every second row.

name: colBandSize

name: border.left

name: border.right

name: border.top
description: outer top border. Format: STYLE[;SIZE[;COLOR[;SPACE]]]. Add/Set only — table-level border readback is not surfaced today; inspect per-cell border.top instead.

name: border.vertical

name: cols

name: data

name: rows

name: effect
description: animation preset. spin/grow/bold/wave require class=emphasis; appear/fade/fly/zoom/wipe/bounce/float/swivel/split/wheel/checkerboard/blinds/dissolve/flash/box/circle/diamond/plus/strips/wedge/random work for entrance and exit. Sixteen additional exit effects are backed by verbatim PowerPoint OOXML templates (anim primitives copied byte-for-byte from a PowerPoint-authored deck): contract, centerRevolve, collapse, floatOut, shrinkTurn, sinkDown, spinner, basicZoom, stretchy, boomerang, credits, curveDown, pinwheel, spiralOut, basicSwivel — these require class=exit. The plain 'float' effect is the Exciting-menu Float (preset 30); use 'floatOut' for the Moderate-menu Float Out (preset 42). Template effects ignore the duration prop (they keep PowerPoint's authored timing). (disappear is not supported — use class=exit + appear or fade.)

name: class
description: animation category — entrance, exit, emphasis, or motion. spin/grow/wave only work with emphasis; motion needs path=<preset|custom>.

name: path
description: Motion-path preset (only valid when class=motion). 'custom' requires d=<SVG-like path data>. Direction-aware presets (line, arc) accept direction= for variants. Note: use class=motion + path=<preset>, not type=motionPath — the latter is not a recognized property.

name: d
description: Custom motion-path data (SVG-like; only valid when class=motion and path=custom). Coords are relative to slide (0..1). Must end with 'E' (auto-appended if missing).

name: trigger
description: trigger mode

name: duration
description: Animation duration in milliseconds (integer, e.g. 500 = 0.5s).

name: delay
description: Delay before starting in milliseconds (integer, e.g. 500 = 0.5s).

name: direction
description: direction for directional effects (in/out/left/right/up/down). Accepts the aliases 'top' (= up) and 'bottom' (= down), plus single-letter forms l/r/u/d; all normalize to the canonical in/out/left/right/up/down on readback.

name: repeat
description: Number of times the animation repeats. Accepts a positive integer (e.g. 3) or the literal 'indefinite' to loop forever. Stored as OOXML @repeatCount (count*1000 or 'indefinite').

name: restart
description: What happens when the trigger fires again after the animation has played. always = restart; whenNotActive = restart only if not currently playing; never = do nothing.

name: autoReverse
description: When true, the animation plays forward then in reverse, doubling its visible run. Maps to OOXML cTn @autoRev.

name: presetId
description: raw OOXML preset id for the animation effect. Emitted when the effect has a recognized preset.

name: easein
description: acceleration percentage (0..100) — fraction of the duration spent ramping up.

name: easeout
description: deceleration percentage (0..100) — fraction of the duration spent ramping down.

name: motionPath
description: motion-path SVG-like path string (animMotion @path) for path animations.

name: chartBuild
description: Chart-internal build animation (only valid when the parent path is /slide[N]/chart[M]). Controls how chart elements appear under the entrance effect: asWhole (default — entire chart as one), series (one series at a time), category (one category at a time), seriesEl (each data point per series), categoryEl (each data point per category). Aliases accepted on input: bySeries, byCategory, bySeriesEl, byCategoryEl. Writes <a:bldChart bld='...'/> inside <p:bldGraphic><p:bldSub>. chartBuild is chart-wide — setting it via any /slide[N]/chart[M]/animation[K] propagates to every animation on the chart.

name: direction
description: Chart-level reading direction. rtl stamps a:rtl="1" on chartSpace c:txPr lvl1pPr so default text bodies (axis labels, data labels) render right-to-left for Arabic / Hebrew.

name: id
description: cNvPr chart id; @id in /chart[@id=ID]. add honors a caller-supplied id so dump-replay keeps it stable for spTgt animation refs; immutable after creation.

name: zorder
description: 1-based z-order in slide shape tree. On add, positions the chart within the shape tree (1 = back). Post-creation reordering is not supported via Set; use Move/Swap on the chart graphic frame, or raw-set the spTree child order.

name: chartType
description: pptx override: chartType is consumed by AddChart (creation only). Switching chart type post-creation is not supported — rebuild the chart with the new type. INPUT is lenient and accepts friendly aliases (stackedArea, bar3D, percentStackedColumn, stackedLine, percentStackedBar, ...) which round-trip correctly. READBACK (Get) is intentionally NOT symmetric with input: it returns the systematic `base_modifier` token form — e.g. area_stacked, area_percentStacked, bar_stacked, bar_percentStacked, bar3d, column_stacked, column_percentStacked, line_stacked, line_percentStacked, pieOfPie, barOfPie. This canonical-readback form is by design (one systematic token per geometry); do not expect the readback to echo the friendly input alias.

name: lineJoin
description: line join style at connector corners (drawingML <a:ln> child <a:round/> | <a:bevel/> | <a:miter/>). Accepts compound 'miter:<lim>' to also set the miter limit in one key.

name: headEnd

name: fromSide
description: which edge of the 'from' shape the line leaves. Omitted (default) = auto-pick the edge facing the 'to' shape (right↔left for a same-row layout, bottom↔top for stacked) so the line spans the gap instead of crossing both boxes. 'center' pins the endpoint to the shape center (line enters the box), reproducing the legacy center-to-center look on demand. Drives the drawn geometry (offset/extent); the endpoint still follows the shape when it moves, but re-anchors to the auto edge (sides are not persisted).

name: toSide
description: which edge of the 'to' shape the line enters. See fromSide; default auto-picks the edge facing the 'from' shape.

name: fromIdx
description: low-level connection-site index on the 'from' shape (writes <a:stCxn idx>). Prefer fromSide unless you know the preset's cxnLst ordering. 0-based; defaults to 0.

name: toIdx
description: low-level connection-site index on the 'to' shape (writes <a:endCxn idx>). Prefer toSide. 0-based; defaults to 0.

name: startShape
description: shape id of the start connection endpoint.

name: startIdx
description: connection point index on start shape (0-based; emitted whenever the start endpoint is connected, 0 = default anchor). Get-side readback of fromIdx.

name: endShape
description: shape id of the end connection endpoint.

name: endIdx
description: connection point index on end shape (0-based; emitted whenever the end endpoint is connected, 0 = default anchor). Get-side readback of toIdx.

name: zorder
description: 1-based z-order in slide shape tree. Add accepts 'top'/'bottom'/'forward'/'backward'/integer (same vocabulary as shape/picture/group); Get returns the resolved integer position.

name: mermaid
description: Mermaid diagram source. Canonical (mirrors equation's 'formula'). Aliases: text, dsl. The first line's header (flowchart TD / sequenceDiagram / ...) selects the diagram kind.

name: src
description: Path to a .mmd file to load the mermaid source from (used when no inline mermaid/text/dsl is given). Consistent with picture/media 'src' = a file path. Alias: path.

name: x
description: Top-left X of the diagram's box (cm/in/pt/EMU). Default: centred horizontally on the slide. The slide size is never changed (use poster=true for that).

name: y
description: Top-left Y of the diagram's box (cm/in/pt/EMU). Default: centred vertically on the slide.

name: width
description: Width of the box the diagram is scaled to fit (cm/in/pt/EMU). Aspect ratio is preserved (may letterbox against height). Default: the slide content width. Mirrors picture/chart 'width'.

name: height
description: Height of the box the diagram is scaled to fit (cm/in/pt/EMU). Aspect ratio is preserved. Default: the slide content height.

name: poster
description: Controls slide growth for a long diagram. UNSET (default) = ADAPTIVE: the diagram fits the current slide, but if fitting would shrink it below readability it auto-grows the slide to the diagram's natural size instead (clamped to PowerPoint's 56in/142.24cm max). true = always grow the slide (export-a-diagram-as-a-slide). false = always fit the current slide even if the result is tiny. Ignored when an explicit x/y/width/height box is given.

name: render
description: How to render. auto (default): use real mermaid.js via a headless browser (Chrome/Chromium/Edge) when available — covers EVERY mermaid type (gantt/pie/class/state/er/…) at full fidelity, embedded as a PNG with the mermaid source stamped into alt-text (regenerable); falls back to the native synthesizer when no browser is present. native: always the built-in editable-shape synthesizer (no browser; supported subset only; fully editable in PowerPoint). image: force the browser path (errors if no browser). mermaid.js is fetched once to a local cache (mirror d.officecli.ai, CDN fallback).

name: theme
description: mermaid color theme (image render only): default (light), dark, neutral, forest, base. Baked into the source as frontmatter, so it round-trips in alt-text and a regenerate reproduces it. Ignored by render=native. Uses the ESM mermaid build, loaded from the CDN (a styled diagram currently needs network on render; plain diagrams stay offline-cached).

name: layout
description: flowchart layout engine (image render only): dagre (default, curved edges) or elk (Eclipse Layout Kernel — orthogonal edge routing, tighter layered placement). elk loads the @mermaid-js/layout-elk ESM package from the CDN. Ignored by render=native.

name: look
description: visual style (image render only): classic (default) or handDrawn (sketchy rough.js strokes). Baked into the source frontmatter; round-trips in alt-text. Ignored by render=native.

name: background
description: render background: transparent (default), a #hex, or a CSS color word. Applied at render time (mmdc -b / page background); does not round-trip in alt-text. Values with whitespace/quotes fall back to transparent.

name: id
description: cNvPr equation id. add honors a caller-supplied id so dump-replay keeps it stable for spTgt animation refs; immutable after creation.

name: formula
description: math expression. Aliases: text.

NOTE: bare numeric indices count ALL top-level shapes in z-order — including existing groups, pictures, and charts — NOT the <p:sp>-only shape[N] address space. So on a slide whose tree is [group, shapeC, shapeD], `shapes=1,2` selects the group + shapeC (z-order positions 1,2). name: ungroup
description: dissolve the group: promote its members back onto the slide with transforms flattened to slide-absolute coordinates, then remove the empty group. Set-only, terminal (other props on the same command are ignored). Inverse of add-group.

name: keepAspect

name: link

name: italic

name: size
description: paragraph default run font size (points). Stored on the paragraph's defRPr (@sz, units of 1/100 pt) and inherited by every run that does not override `size`. Folded onto the paragraph by dump when every run shares the same value.

name: lang
description: BCP-47 language tag stamped on the paragraph's defRPr (@lang). Folded onto the paragraph by dump when every run shares the same lang value (single-run collapse). See pptx/run.json for full semantics.

name: list

name: tabs

name: indent

name: id
description: cNvPr picture id; @id in /picture[@id=ID]. add honors a caller-supplied id so dump-replay keeps it stable for spTgt animation refs; immutable after creation.

name: mediaType

name: flipH
description: mirror the picture horizontally (left-right). Mirrors shape/connector flip — stored on the same a:xfrm @flipH attribute. Pass false to clear.

name: flipV
description: mirror the picture vertically (top-bottom). Mirrors shape/connector flip — stored on the same a:xfrm @flipV attribute. Pass false to clear.

description: click-hyperlink target attached to the picture's cNvPr (so the whole image is clickable). Accepts absolute URI (https://, mailto:), slide[N] for in-deck jumps, or named actions (firstslide, lastslide, nextslide, previousslide). Pass 'none' or empty to clear.

description: hover tooltip text for the click-hyperlink. Applied together with `link` in a single set/add call; standalone tooltip change without link is not supported.

name: opacity
description: picture opacity. Input as a decimal 0.0-1.0 or a percent 2-100. Stored on the blip as a:alphaModFix @amt (value * 100000); readback emits the decimal 0.0-1.0 form.

name: brightness

name: contrast
description: luminance contrast in [-100, 100]. Stored on the blip as a:lum @contrast (value * 1000). Combine with `brightness`.

name: shadow
description: outer shadow as `color-blur-angle-dist-opacity` (mirrors shape `shadow`). Input color is hex (with or without `#`, 6- or 8-digit `RRGGBBAA`) or a scheme name; blur/dist in points; angle in degrees; opacity 0-100. name: glow

name: cropLeft

name: font
description: bare font family — write-only convenience that sets the latin/ea/cs script slots to the same value. Get normalizes the readback to per-script canonical keys (font.latin / font.ea / font.cs) so a get→set round-trip preserves divergent slot values.

name: baseline
description: vertical alignment in % of font height. Accepts 'super' (≡ +30), 'sub' (≡ -25), 'none'/'false'/'0', or a signed number. Get readback is the %-suffixed percentage.

name: highlight
description: text highlight color behind the glyphs (a:highlight). Unlike Word's fixed named-color list, accepts any color (hex, named, rgb(), scheme names like accent1). 'none'/'false' removes the highlight on set.

name: kern
description: minimum font size (in hundredths of a point) at which character kerning is applied. ECMA-376 §21.1.2.3.9 a:rPr/@kern. 0 disables; 1 enables for all sizes; e.g. 1200 = kern from 12pt up.

name: spacing
description: character spacing in points. Stored as 1/100 pt in OOXML (a:rPr/@spc); readback is the point value. Negative values tighten.

name: lang
description: BCP-47 language tag for the run (ECMA-376 §21.1.2.3.9 a:rPr/@lang). DrawingML exposes a single primary-language slot — there is no per-script (latin/ea/cs) split like Word; 'lang.latin' is accepted as an alias on input, 'lang.ea'/'lang.cs' are rejected. Validated against a BCP-47 shape, max 35 chars.

name: textOutline
description: text outline / glyph stroke (a:rPr/a:ln). Compound form 'width:color' (mirrors connector 'line='); split forms 'textOutline.width' and 'textOutline.color' allow additive Set. Pass 'none' or 'false' to clear.

name: textOutline.color
description: text outline colour (a:rPr/a:ln/a:solidFill). Accepts #RRGGBB, named colors, rgb(...), or scheme tokens.

name: textOutline.width
description: text outline stroke width (a:rPr/a:ln/@w). Accepts pt/cm/in/emu units.

name: cap
description: none | small | all

name: effective.font
description: resolved font name inherited from placeholder→layout→master→presentation defaults. Suppressed when 'font' is set directly on the run.

name: subscript
description: vertical alignment = subscript (sugar for baseline=sub). Mutually exclusive with superscript. Get readback uses canonical 'baseline' (not surfaced as 'subscript').

name: superscript
description: vertical alignment = superscript (sugar for baseline=super). Mutually exclusive with subscript. Get readback uses canonical 'baseline' (not surfaced as 'superscript').

name: effective.bold
description: resolved bold inherited from placeholder→layout→master→presentation defaults. Suppressed when 'bold' is set directly on the run.

name: effective.color
description: resolved text color inherited from placeholder→layout→master→presentation defaults. Suppressed when 'color' is set directly on the run.

name: effective.size
description: inheritance-resolved font size (read-only). Surfaced when the run does not set 'size' directly; resolved through run style → paragraph style → docDefaults.

name: underline
description: underline style. Common values: single, double, dotted, dash, wave, none.

name: bold
description: true | false

name: color
description: #RRGGBB uppercase

name: italic
description: true | false

name: size
description: unit-qualified, e.g. "14pt"

name: text
description: plain text of run

name: size
description: font size — Add/Set forwards to the first run; Get returns the bare size when every run shares the same explicit FontSize (non-mixed). When sizes are mixed or no run carries an explicit size, bare size is suppressed and the inheritance-resolved effective.size is emitted instead.

name: evaluated
description: cross-handler protocol flag — emitted on shapes whose body contains an <a:fld> dynamic field (slide number, date-time, footer, etc.). True when every dynamic field has cached text the renderer can show; false when at least one is empty (view text substitutes #OCLI_NOTEVAL!{type}; view issues emits subtype slide_field_not_evaluated). PowerPoint always re-renders fields on open, so there is no cache_stale equivalent. Read this via get --json instead of pattern-matching the sentinel.

name: isTitle
description: true when this shape is the slide title placeholder (or a content placeholder configured as title). Always emitted on every shape so query selectors like `shape[isTitle=true]` and `shape[isTitle=false]` resolve uniformly. Read-only — title-ness is determined by placeholder type at Add time, not as a settable property.

name: opacity
description: fill opacity (0.0 - 1.0). Requires a fill to attach to — opacity alone (without fill/gradient/pattern) has no effect in OOXML.

name: geometry
description: Preset shape geometry (default: rect). The values list below is illustrative, not exhaustive — many more OOXML presets are accepted (handler-as-truth): pie, arc, chord, the directional arrows (leftArrow, upArrow, downArrow), star4/star6/star8/star10, hexagon/heptagon/octagon/decagon/dodecagon, cloud, plus the callout* family, etc. Any preset the handler recognizes round-trips.

name: adj
description: Preset adjust handles (a:prstGeom/a:avLst/a:gd). Controls the parametric proportions of a preset (arrow tail/head size, roundRect corner radius, star inner ratio, etc.). Format is "name:formula" where formula is an OOXML guide formula such as "val 6000". Multiple handles are comma-separated.

name: textFill
description: Fill applied to the text glyphs (a:rPr fill). Accepts a color (solid glyph fill) or round-trips a gradient. The legacy alias 'textGradient' canonicalizes to 'textFill' on readback.

name: textWarp
description: WordArt text warp preset applied to the shape's text body (a:bodyPr/a:prstTxWarp @prst). Use 'none' to remove. The HTML preview surfaces the active warp as a data-textwarp attribute + a 'text-warp' marker class on the shape; real PowerPoint renders the per-glyph warp path.

name: font.latin
description: Latin-script font slot only (a:latin). Use to target ASCII/European text without overwriting CJK / complex-script slots.

name: font.ea
description: East-Asian font slot (a:ea) — Chinese / Japanese / Korean text.

name: font.cs
description: Complex-script font slot (a:cs) — Arabic / Hebrew / Thai etc.

name: direction
description: paragraph reading direction (a:pPr rtl). Use 'rtl' for Arabic / Hebrew layouts.

name: margin
description: uniform internal padding (text inset) for shape body (a:bodyPr lIns/tIns/rIns/bIns). Also accepts a 4-value 'l,t,r,b' form on Set.

name: textDirection
description: shape text rotation (a:bodyPr @vert) — works on shapes/textboxes, not just table cells. horizontal|vertical90|vertical270|eaVert|stacked. Round-trips through the same canonical vocabulary as table-cell textDirection. Note: the Get readback key is lowercase 'textdirection'.

name: strike
description: strikethrough on shape text. Single and double are distinct OOXML tokens (sngStrike / dblStrike); Word splits these into `strike` + `dstrike`, PowerPoint folds both into one attribute.

name: highlight
description: text highlight color behind the glyphs (a:highlight). Unlike Word's fixed named-color list, accepts any color (hex, named, rgb(), scheme names like accent1). 'none'/'false' removes the highlight.

name: cap
description: letter-case rendering mode for shape text (rPr/cap).

name: lang
description: BCP-47 language tag. lang lives per-run (drawingML a:rPr/@lang) — a shape has no language of its own, only an aggregate of differently-tongued runs. add/set on a shape is a convenience that writes the FIRST run's rPr; read it back at run scope (/shape[N]/paragraph[P]/run[R]). Not surfaced at shape level: a first-run projection cannot say which language each run is, and a newly added run would not inherit it.

name: spacing
description: character spacing in points. Stored as 1/100 pt in OOXML (a:rPr/@spc); readback is the point value. Negative values tighten.

name: kern
description: minimum kerning size in 1/100 pt (drawingML rPr/@kern). Get surfaces the raw integer via long-tail rPr attribute readback.

name: autoFit
description: text body auto-fit mode. 'normal'/'shrink' shrinks text to fit (normAutofit); 'shape' resizes the shape to fit text; 'none' overflows. Aliases (Add+Set): true/shrink → normal, resize → shape, false → none.

name: fontScale
description: normAutofit font-scale (shrink-to-fit text ratio). Input as a percent: bare integer 0-100 (75 → 75%) or N% form ('75%'). Stored as OOXML thousandths-of-percent (75000); readback emits the raw OOXML integer.

name: lnSpcReduction
description: normAutofit line-space reduction (shrink-to-fit spacing ratio). Input as a percent: bare integer 0-100 (20 → 20%) or N% form ('20%'). Stored as OOXML thousandths-of-percent (20000); readback emits the raw OOXML integer.

name: lineSpacing
description: line spacing for shape paragraphs (multiplier or pt).

name: spaceBefore
description: unit-qualified pt

name: spaceAfter
description: unit-qualified pt

name: gradient
description: gradient fill spec. Linear: 'C1-C2[-ANGLE]' or 'LINEAR;C1;C2;ANGLE'. Radial: 'radial:C1-C2[-FOCUS]' (focus: tl/tr/bl/br/center). Path: 'path:C1-C2[-FOCUS]'. Per-stop position: 'C@PCT' (e.g. 'FF0000@0-0000FF@100').

name: pattern
description: pattern fill: 'preset' or 'preset:fg' or 'preset:fg:bg' (defaults: fg=000000, bg=FFFFFF).

name: image
description: image (blip) fill: path to a local image file used as the shape fill.

name: fillRect
description: image-fill stretch insets as "l,t,r,b" in thousandths of a percent (perMille). Positive insets letterbox the image inside the shape; negative insets oversize it (cover-style framing). Applies to an image (blipFill) shape; consumed alongside image=.

name: srcRect
description: image-fill source crop as "l,t,r,b" in thousandths of a percent (perMille) — the fraction trimmed from each edge of the source image before it fills the shape. Applies to an image (blipFill) shape; consumed alongside image=.

name: lineWidth
description: outline width.

name: lineDash
description: outline dash pattern (drawingML prstDash). Also reachable as the third segment of the compound line='color:width:style' form.

name: lineGradient
description: gradient outline (drawingML <a:ln>/<a:gradFill>). Accepts a stop list 'color@pos,color@pos,...' (pos in percent) with an optional 'angle=Ndeg' segment, mirroring the fill gradient form. Set/Add replace any solid outline color. Get readback is emitted under the canonical key 'line.gradient'.

name: lineCap
description: line end cap style (drawingML <a:ln @cap>). Affects how the stroke terminates at endpoints (and dash gaps for dashed strokes).

name: lineJoin
description: line join style at shape corners (drawingML <a:ln> child <a:round/> | <a:bevel/> | <a:miter/>). Accepts compound 'miter:<lim>' to also set the miter limit in one key.

name: miterLimit
description: miter join limit (drawingML <a:miter @lim>) in 1000ths of a percent (e.g. 800000 = 800%). Implies lineJoin=miter when set without an explicit lineJoin.

name: cmpd
description: compound line style (drawingML <a:ln @cmpd>) for double/triple/asymmetric strokes.

name: lineAlign
description: stroke alignment relative to the path (drawingML <a:ln @algn>). 'ctr' centers the stroke on the path; 'in' insets it inside the shape boundary.

name: headEnd
description: arrowhead at the line's start (drawingML <a:headEnd type=...>). Supported on any outline (shape or connector), not connector-only.

name: tailEnd
description: arrowhead at the line's end (drawingML <a:tailEnd type=...>). Supported on any outline (shape or connector).

name: list
description: list style for shape paragraphs (bullet|numbered|alpha|roman|none|<char>).

name: link
description: click-action target for the shape. Accepts an absolute URI (https://, mailto:, tel:, …), slide[N] for an in-deck jump (1-based; the target slide must already exist), or a named navigation action (firstslide, lastslide, nextslide, previousslide, endshow). Pass 'none' or empty to clear.

name: tooltip
description: tooltip / screen-tip text for hyperlink. Applied together with `link` in a single set/add call; standalone tooltip without link is not supported (no hyperlink relationship to attach to). Set-side may update an existing hyperlink's tooltip in-place without re-supplying link.

name: animation
