name: id
description: cNvPr shape id; @id in /shape[@id=ID]. add honors a caller-supplied id so dump-replay keeps it stable for spTgt animation refs; immutable after creation.

name: zorder
description: 1-based z-order in slide shape tree. On add/set, repositions the shape within the shape tree (1 = back).

name: bevel
description: 3-D top bevel descriptor (sp3d.bevelT). Form: 'preset[-width[-height]]' with width/height in points; height defaults to width. Preset values: angle, artDeco, circle, convex, coolSlant, cross, divot, hardEdge, relaxedInset, riblet, slope, softRound. Example: 'circle-6-6'.

name: bevelBottom
description: 3-D bottom bevel descriptor (sp3d.bevelB). Same grammar as 'bevel'. Single-size shorthand 'preset-N' sets width=height=N.

name: depth
description: 3-D extrusion height (sp3d @extrusionH). Accepts the canonical length input forms — bare number is points, also accepts pt/cm/in/px/emu suffix. 'none' or '0' clears.

name: lighting
description: 3-D scene lighting rig name (scene3d.lightRig @rig). OOXML preset rig values: threePt, balanced, soft, harsh, flood, contrasting, morning, sunrise, sunset, chilly, freezing, flat, twoPt, glow, brightRoom.

name: material
description: 3-D preset material (sp3d.prstMaterial). Accepted tokens (case-insensitive): clear, darkEdge (alias dkEdge), flat, matte, metal, plastic, powder, softEdge, softMetal, translucentPowder, warmMatte, wireframe (alias wire).

name: reflection
description: reflection effect. Accepts 'true' / 'tight' / 'half' / 'full' to enable a reflection of varying length, or 'none' to clear.

name: shadow
description: outer shadow. Pass a color (e.g. '000000') or 'true' (defaults to black). Routed to text-level rPr for text-only shapes.

name: innerShadow
description: inner shadow (a:innerShdw) as `color-blur-angle-dist-opacity` (mirrors `shadow`). Input color is hex (with or without `#`, 6- or 8-digit `RRGGBBAA`) or a scheme name (with optional +lumMod/+shade transforms); blur/dist in points; angle in degrees; opacity 0-100. Rendered as a CSS inset box-shadow in the HTML preview.

name: glow
description: glow effect. Pass a color (e.g. '4472C4') or 'true' (defaults to accent blue).

name: flipH
description: Flip horizontally (Office-API alias of flip=h).

name: flipV
description: Flip vertically (Office-API alias of flip=v).

name: lineOpacity
description: shape outline alpha as fraction (0..1). Requires an outline (line/lineColor) to attach to. Surfaces when the outline carries an a:alpha child.

name: x
description: x in EMU/length form (e.g. 2cm). pptx absolute positioning.

name: y
description: y in EMU/length form (e.g. 2cm). pptx absolute positioning.

name: width
description: width in EMU/length form (e.g. 2cm). pptx absolute positioning.

name: height
description: height in EMU/length form (e.g. 2cm). pptx absolute positioning.

name: align
description: Paragraph alignment: 'left' / 'center' (c/ctr) / 'right' (r) / 'justify'.

name: bold
description: Bold runs. Bare alias of font.bold.

name: color
description: Text color. Bare alias of font.color.

name: fill
description: Solid fill color, or 'none' for no fill (text-only shapes route effects to text-level rPr). Accepts color-transform modifiers appended with '+': '+lumMod<N>' / '+lumOff<N>' (luminance, percent), '+tint<N>' / '+shade<N>', '+alpha<N>' (e.g. 'accent1+lumMod75', 'FF0000+lumMod50', 'accent2+shade60+alpha80'). Modifiers apply to both scheme and srgb base colors and round-trip in Get.

name: font
description: default font family for shape text. Bare 'font' targets Latin + EastAsian; for per-script control (Japanese / Korean / Arabic) use font.latin, font.ea, or font.cs.

name: italic
description: Italic runs. Bare alias of font.italic.

name: line
description: Outline color (or 'none'). Form: 'color[:width[:style]]', e.g. 'FF0000:1.5:dash'. width in points; style: solid|dash|dot|dashdot|longdash.

name: name
description: Override the auto-generated 'Shape {id}' label on cNvPr @name.

name: rotation
description: Rotation in degrees (positive = clockwise). Stored OOXML-internal as 60000ths of a degree on Transform2D @rot.

name: softEdge
description: Soft edge radius, or 'none' to clear.

name: text
description: plain text content of the shape

name: underline
description: Underline style: 'true'/'single'/'sng', 'double'/'dbl', 'none'/'false'. Bare alias of font.underline.

name: valign
description: Vertical anchor: 'top' (t) / 'center' (ctr/middle/c/m) / 'bottom' (b).

name: layout
description: slide layout name (e.g. 'Title Slide', 'Title and Content'). Resolved against the presentation's slide masters. The `layout` property is metadata only — placeholder slots defined in the layout are NOT auto-materialized on the slide. To populate slots: pass `--prop title=…` to auto-emit a title placeholder shape (phType=title); pass `--prop text=…` to auto-emit a body placeholder shape (phType=body); or add placeholders explicitly with `--type placeholder --prop phType=<role>`.

name: title
description: title text. Creates a Title shape at Add time, carrying <p:ph type="title"/>. To modify or read the title text after creation, target the title shape directly (e.g. /slide[N]/shape[@phType=title]).

name: text
description: content body text. Creates a Content text shape at Add time, carrying <p:ph type="body" idx="1"/> so it binds to the layout's body slot.

name: background
description: slide background. Accepts: hex color (`#RGB`, `#RRGGBB`, `#RRGGBBAA` for solid+alpha), scheme color (`accent1`..`accent6`, `dark1`, `dark2`, `light1`, `light2`, `hyperlink`, `followedHyperlink`), `transparent` (or `none`/`clear`), linear gradient `C1-C2[-C3][-angle]` (angle in degrees, also accepts `LINEAR;C1;C2[;angle]`), radial gradient `radial:C1-C2[-focus]` (focus: `tl`/`tr`/`bl`/`br`/`center`), path gradient `path:C1-C2[-focus]`, and image fill `image:/path/to/file` (local path; pair with `background.mode`/`background.alpha`/`background.scale`).

name: transition
description: transition name (fade, push, wipe, morph, etc.). 'morph...' triggers auto-prefixing of shape names.

name: advanceTime
description: auto-advance time in milliseconds (integer). e.g. 5000 = 5 seconds.

name: advanceClick
description: advance on click.

name: notes
description: slide notes text. Set-only at creation time.

name: hidden
description: true when the slide is hidden from slideshow (Slide/@show=false).

name: name
description: slide name (cSld/@name) — shown by PowerPoint accessibility/VBA tooling and preserved on round-trip.

name: layoutType
description: slide layout type name as encoded on the underlying SlideLayout (e.g. blank, title, titleOnly, twoContent, obj, txAndObj). Distinct from `layout`, which is the user-facing layout display name.

name: background.alpha
description: slide background fill alpha as percent (0..100). Settable on existing solid or image backgrounds: on solid, rewrites the color with the given alpha (equivalent to `background=RRGGBBAA`); on image, emits `<a:alphaModFix/>`. Surfaces on get when the resolved fill carries an alpha channel.

name: background.crop
description: slide background image crop quad in `l,t,r,b` percent units (CT_RelativeRect).

name: background.mode
description: slide background image fill mode — `stretch` (default), `tile`, or `center`. Settable on an existing image background; emitted on get only when non-default.

name: background.ref
description: theme background reference index — bgRef/@idx (1001/1002/1003 etc.) when the slide inherits from the theme.

name: background.scale
description: tile-fill scale percent (sx, both axes), 1..500. Settable on an existing image background with background.mode=tile; surfaces on get with background.mode=tile.

name: matchedShapes
description: morph transition: number of shapes from the previous slide that matched on the current slide.

name: morphMode
description: morph transition mode (byObject default, or other p:morph @option token).

name: morphShapes
description: morph transition: number of candidate shapes considered for matching on this slide.

name: name
description: layout display name (e.g. 'Title Slide').

name: background
description: layout background — propagates to every slide bound to this layout unless the slide overrides. Accepts hex color (#FF6600), bare hex (FF6600), theme color (accent1/dark1/...), gradient (`C1-C2[-angle]`), image (`image:/path`), or `none` to clear (re-inherits from the owning master).

name: background.alpha
description: layout background fill alpha as percent (0..100). Settable on an existing image background; surfaces on get when the resolved fill carries an alpha channel.

name: background.crop
description: layout background image crop quad in `l,t,r,b` percent units.

name: background.mode
description: layout background image fill mode — `stretch` (default), `tile`, or `center`. Settable on an existing image background; emitted on get only when non-default.

name: background.ref
description: theme background reference index — bgRef/@idx when the layout inherits from the theme.

name: background.scale
description: tile-fill scale percent (sx, both axes), 1..500. Settable on an existing image background with background.mode=tile; surfaces on get with background.mode=tile.

name: direction
description: default reading direction. Cascades `<a:pPr rtl="1"/>` onto every placeholder paragraph in this layout, and stamps the owning master's txStyles Level1 default (since blank layouts have no placeholders for inheriting shapes to probe). Accepts `ltr`/`rtl` or boolean for the `rtl` alias.

name: type
description: layout type (title, obj, twoObj, etc.).

name: name
description: master part name from CommonSlideData/@name.

name: background
description: master background — propagates to every slide bound (directly or via a layout) to this master unless the slide or layout overrides. Accepts hex color (#FF6600), bare hex (FF6600), theme color (accent1/dark1/...), gradient (`C1-C2[-angle]`), image (`image:/path`), or `none` to clear.

name: background.alpha
description: master background fill alpha as percent (0..100). Settable on an existing image background; surfaces on get when the resolved fill carries an alpha channel.

name: background.crop
description: master background image crop quad in `l,t,r,b` percent units.

name: background.mode
description: master background image fill mode — `stretch` (default), `tile`, or `center`. Settable on an existing image background; emitted on get only when non-default.

name: background.ref
description: theme background reference index — bgRef/@idx when the master inherits from the theme.

name: background.scale
description: tile-fill scale percent (sx, both axes), 1..500. Settable on an existing image background with background.mode=tile; surfaces on get with background.mode=tile.

name: direction
description: default reading direction propagated into the master's txStyles (Level1ParagraphProperties of body/title/other) and cascaded onto existing placeholder paragraphs. Accepts `ltr`/`rtl` or boolean for the `rtl` alias.

name: layoutCount
description: number of slide layouts associated with this master.

name: theme
description: name of the theme attached to this master, when the theme has a name.

name: shapeCount
description: count of background shapes (Shape + Picture) on the master's shape tree.

name: id
description: cNvPr graphic-frame id; @id in /table[@id=ID]. add honors a caller-supplied id so dump-replay keeps it stable for spTgt animation refs; immutable after creation.

name: zorder
description: z-order in slide shape tree. On add, positions the table (1 = back). On set, re-stacks it: front/back/forward/backward, +1/-1, or a 1-based absolute index.

name: x
description: left offset in EMU-parseable length.

name: y
description: cm-formatted length

name: height
description: cm-formatted length

name: rowHeight
description: uniform row height (EMU). On add, if unspecified it's derived from 'height' / rows. On set, applies the given height to EVERY row (a convenience for `tr[R] --prop height` on each); read individual heights back per-row via `tr[R]`.

name: colWidths
description: per-column widths as comma- or semicolon-separated lengths (EMU/cm/in/pt). Length must match 'cols'; extra/missing entries fall back to the uniform default. Get readback is comma-separated FormatEmu output.

name: headerFill
description: solid fill color applied to row 0 (header).

name: bodyFill
description: solid fill color applied to rows 1..N (body).

name: firstRow
description: tblPr @firstRow flag — header-row styling enabled.

name: lastRow
description: tblPr @lastRow flag — total-row styling enabled.

name: firstCol
description: tblPr @firstCol flag — first-column styling enabled.

name: lastCol
description: tblPr @lastCol flag — last-column styling enabled.

name: bandedRows
description: tblPr @bandRow flag — alternating row banding from the table style.

name: bandedCols
description: tblPr @bandCol flag — alternating column banding from the table style.

name: border.all
description: shorthand: applies the border to every edge of every cell. PPT OOXML has no table-level border element — this fans out to per-cell a:lnL/lnR/lnT/lnB. Format: 'WIDTH[ DASH][ COLOR]' space-separated (e.g. '1pt solid FF0000') or 'STYLE;WIDTH;COLOR[;DASH]' semicolon form (style is ignored — kept for docx parity). DASH ∈ solid|dot|dash|lgDash|dashDot|sysDot|sysDash. Use 'none' to clear. Alias: border. Cross-format note: docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' — pptx is more lenient.

name: border.bottom
description: outer bottom border. Format: STYLE[;SIZE[;COLOR[;SPACE]]]. Cross-format note: pptx accepts a space-separated 'WIDTH DASH COLOR' form; docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR'. Add/Set only — read per-cell.

name: border.horizontal
description: inside-horizontal dividers (between rows). Fans out to bottom of rows 1..N-1 plus top of rows 2..N. PPT has no native inside-border element. Alias: border.insideH. Cross-format note: docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' — pptx is more lenient.

name: border.left
description: outer left edge: applies to the left of column-1 cells in every row only. Format same as border.all. Cross-format note: docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' — pptx is more lenient.

name: border.right
description: outer right edge: applies to the right of last-column cells in every row only. Format same as border.all. Cross-format note: docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' — pptx is more lenient.

name: border.top
description: outer top border. Format: STYLE[;SIZE[;COLOR[;SPACE]]]. Cross-format note: pptx accepts a space-separated 'WIDTH DASH COLOR' form; docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' (SIZE is in 1/8 pt units). Add/Set only — table-level border readback is not surfaced today; inspect per-cell border.top instead.

name: border.vertical
description: inside-vertical dividers (between columns). Fans out to right of cols 1..M-1 plus left of cols 2..M. Alias: border.insideV. Cross-format note: docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' — pptx is more lenient.

name: name
description: NonVisualDrawingProperties Name (used for stable @name addressing).

name: cols
description: number of columns (ignored if 'data' is supplied).

name: data
description: inline CSV-ish data ('H1,H2;R1C1,R1C2') or CSV file/URL/data-URI resolvable by FileSource. Both forms are quote-aware: wrap a cell in double quotes to keep a comma (or a row separator) inside it, and double the quote to write a literal one.

name: rows
description: number of rows (ignored if 'data' is supplied).

name: width
description: table width in twips (Dxa) or percent ('50%' → Pct).

name: style
description: table style name or GUID (accepted aliases: tableStyle, tableStyleId). Valid names: medium1..4, light1..3, dark1..2, none, or a direct {GUID}.

name: text
description: single-run text content. pptx-only override: prefer set tc[C] for cell text in pptx; standalone Add cell rarely has room to land within a rectangular table grid. Set + Get unchanged.

name: colspan
description: horizontal cell span (a:tc @gridSpan) — number of grid columns this cell spans (>=2 means merged across). Setting colspan=N also stamps hMerge=true on the next (N-1) cells in the same row, matching the convenience prop merge.right. Surfaces on Get only when the cell spans more than one column. Canonical name matches docx; alias: gridspan.

name: rowspan
description: vertical cell span (a:tc @rowSpan). Settable: rowspan=N writes rowSpan=N on this anchor cell and vMerge=true on the (N-1) continuation cells directly below. Surfaces on Get only when the cell spans more than one row.

name: padding.left
description: left cell padding (a:tcPr @marL). Read-only readback; emitted as a unit-qualified length (cm/in/pt).

name: padding.right
description: right cell padding (a:tcPr @marR). Read-only readback; emitted as a unit-qualified length.

name: padding.top
description: top cell padding (a:tcPr @marT). Read-only readback; emitted as a unit-qualified length.

name: padding.bottom
description: bottom cell padding (a:tcPr @marB). Read-only readback; emitted as a unit-qualified length.

name: padding
description: shorthand to set all four cell paddings at once (a:tcPr @marL/@marR/@marT/@marB). Accepts a unit-qualified length applied to every edge.

name: valign
description: vertical text anchor (a:tcPr @anchor). top|center|bottom.

name: wrap
description: cell text wrap (a:txBody/a:bodyPr @wrap). true=square (wrap), false=none (clip to cell). Set on the cell's body properties.

name: textdirection
description: cell text rotation (a:tcPr @vert). horizontal|vertical90|vertical270|stacked. Round-trips through the same canonical vocabulary.

name: direction
description: first-paragraph reading direction (a:pPr @rtl). ltr|rtl. Fans out to every paragraph in the cell's text body; readback reflects the first paragraph only.

name: merge.right
description: convenience for horizontal merge — merges N neighbor cells to the right into this one, so the total span becomes N+1 (writes gridSpan=N+1 on this cell and hMerge=true on the next N cells in the same row).

name: merge.down
description: convenience for vertical merge — stamps rowSpan=N on this cell and vMerge=true on the same column in the next N-1 rows.

name: bevel
description: 3-D cell bevel (a:tcPr/a:cell3D). 'none' to clear, or a preset name (circle, slope, cross, angle, softRound, convex, coolSlant, divot, riblet, hardEdge, artDeco, …). Optional 'NAME;Wpt;Hpt' to set width/height.

name: opacity
description: fill alpha as a 0–1 fraction or 0–100 percent (post-applied to the cell's solid/gradient fill).

name: image
description: embed an image file as the cell's blip fill (a:tcPr/a:blipFill). Path to a local image; relationship is added to the slide. Replaces any prior fill.

name: linespacing
description: line spacing applied to every paragraph in the cell. Accepts multiplier ('1.5x', '150%') or fixed points ('18pt').

name: spacebefore
description: space before every paragraph in the cell. Unit-qualified length ('12pt', '0.5cm').

name: spaceafter
description: space after every paragraph in the cell. Unit-qualified length ('12pt', '0.5cm').

name: align
description: first-paragraph horizontal alignment applied to every paragraph in the cell (a:pPr @algn). left|center|right|justify. Readback reflects the first paragraph only.

name: font
description: Latin (and East Asian fallback) font typeface for every run in the cell. Fans out to a:rPr/a:latin + a:ea on every existing run.

name: size
description: font size for every run in the cell (a:rPr @sz). Unit-qualified ('14pt') or bare number (points).

name: bold
description: bold for every run in the cell (a:rPr @b).

name: italic
description: italic for every run in the cell (a:rPr @i).

name: underline
description: underline style for every run in the cell (a:rPr @u). single|double|none or any OOXML underline value.

name: strike
description: strikethrough for every run in the cell (a:rPr @strike). single|double|none.

name: color
description: font color for every run in the cell (a:rPr/a:solidFill).

name: fill
description: cell background fill. Accepts a solid color (hex, named, rgb(...)), scheme color name (accent1–accent6, dk1, dk2, lt1, lt2, hyperlink), 'none' for explicit no-fill, or a gradient string 'COLOR1-COLOR2[-ANGLE]' (e.g. 'FF0000-0000FF-90'). Stored as a:solidFill/a:noFill/a:gradFill on a:tcPr.

name: baseline
description: first run baseline offset for the cell text (percent units; positive=raised).

name: hmerge
description: true on cells continued from a horizontal merge anchor (CT_TableCell @hMerge).

name: vmerge
description: true on cells continued from a vertical merge anchor (CT_TableCell @vMerge). Surfaced by Query for table cells.

name: image.relId
description: relationship id of an embedded image used as the cell's blip fill.

name: border.all
description: all four cell edges. Format: 'WIDTH[ DASH][ COLOR]' (e.g. '1pt solid FF0000') or 'STYLE;WIDTH;COLOR[;DASH]' (style ignored — kept for docx parity). DASH ∈ solid|dot|dash|lgDash|dashDot|sysDot|sysDash. Use 'none' to clear. Alias: border. Stored as a:lnL/lnR/lnT/lnB on a:tcPr. Cross-format note: docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' — pptx is more lenient.

name: border.bottom
description: bottom border. Format: STYLE[;SIZE[;COLOR[;SPACE]]]. Cross-format note: pptx accepts a space-separated 'WIDTH DASH COLOR' form; docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' (SIZE is in 1/8 pt units).

name: border.left
description: left border. Format: STYLE[;SIZE[;COLOR[;SPACE]]]. Cross-format note: pptx accepts a space-separated 'WIDTH DASH COLOR' form; docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' (SIZE is in 1/8 pt units).

name: border.right
description: right border. Format: STYLE[;SIZE[;COLOR[;SPACE]]]. Cross-format note: pptx accepts a space-separated 'WIDTH DASH COLOR' form; docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' (SIZE is in 1/8 pt units).

name: border.tl2br
description: diagonal from top-left to bottom-right (a:lnTlToBr). Format same as border.all. Cross-format note: docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' — pptx is more lenient. Get returns sub-keys border.tl2br.color, border.tl2br.width, border.tl2br.dash, and a summary border.tl2br key.

name: border.top
description: top border. Format: STYLE[;SIZE[;COLOR[;SPACE]]]. Cross-format note: pptx accepts a space-separated 'WIDTH DASH COLOR' form; docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' (SIZE is in 1/8 pt units).

name: border.tr2bl
description: diagonal from top-right to bottom-left (a:lnBlToTr). Format same as border.all. Cross-format note: docx only accepts the semicolon form 'STYLE;SIZE;COLOR' — pptx is more lenient. Get returns sub-keys border.tr2bl.color, border.tr2bl.width, border.tr2bl.dash, and a summary border.tr2bl key.

name: width
description: column width in EMU-parseable length. Defaults to average of existing columns or ~2.54cm.

name: text
description: seed text inserted into every new cell of this column.

name: cols
description: asserts the new row's cell count matches the table grid. The row is structurally locked to the existing <a:tblGrid> — to widen, add a column first (or set gridSpan on cell 1 to merge into a wider span). Defaults to the existing grid column count when omitted.

name: height
description: row height in EMU-parseable length. Defaults to first-row height or ~1cm.

name: text
description: plain text content of the textbox

name: font
description: font family. Bare 'font' targets Latin + EastAsian; for per-script control (Japanese / Korean / Arabic) use font.latin, font.ea, or font.cs.

name: font.latin
description: Latin-script font slot (a:latin) only.

name: font.ea
description: East-Asian font slot (a:ea) — Chinese / Japanese / Korean text.

name: font.cs
description: Complex-script font slot (a:cs) — Arabic / Hebrew / Thai etc.

name: direction
description: paragraph reading direction (a:pPr rtl). Use 'rtl' for Arabic / Hebrew layouts.

name: size
description: font size — Add/Set forwards to the first run; Get exposes the inheritance-resolved value as effective.size, not bare size.

name: bold
description: Add/Set forwards to the first run; Get does not surface bold at the shape level.

name: italic
description: Add/Set forwards to the first run; Get does not surface italic at the shape level.

name: color
description: text color — Add/Set forwards to the first run; Get exposes the inheritance-resolved value as effective.color, not bare color.

name: fill
description: textbox background fill

name: align
description: text horizontal alignment

name: width
description: length in cm

name: height
description: length in cm

name: x
description: horizontal position of the textbox

name: y
description: vertical position of the textbox

name: effective.direction
description: resolved reading direction inherited from placeholder→layout→master→presentation defaults. Suppressed when 'direction' is set directly on the textbox.

name: effective.size
description: resolved font size inherited from placeholder→layout→master→presentation defaults. Suppressed when 'size' is set directly on the textbox.

name: effective.font
description: resolved font name inherited from placeholder→layout→master→presentation defaults. Suppressed when 'font' is set directly on the textbox.

name: effective.color
description: resolved text color inherited from placeholder→layout→master→presentation defaults. Suppressed when 'color' is set directly on the textbox.

name: effective.bold
description: resolved bold inherited from placeholder→layout→master→presentation defaults. Suppressed when 'bold' is set directly on the textbox.

name: autoFit
description: auto-fit mode for the textbox text body. Alias: autofit.

name: valign
description: text vertical anchoring inside the textbox (a:bodyPr anchor). 'middle' is an input alias for 'center' — Get always reads back 'center'.

name: margin
description: text body insets (a:bodyPr lIns/tIns/rIns/bIns). Single value applies to all four sides; CSS-style 4-value form is 'lIns,tIns,rIns,bIns'. '0' / '0cm' is a valid round-trip and is preserved (not collapsed to default).

name: id
description: cNvPr shape id; @id in /shape[@id=ID]. add honors a caller-supplied id so dump-replay keeps it stable for spTgt animation refs; immutable after creation.

name: zorder
description: 1-based z-order in slide shape tree. On add/set, repositions the shape within the shape tree (1 = back).

name: name
description: Override the auto-generated 'TextBox {N}' label on cNvPr @name.

name: lang
description: BCP-47 language tag. lang lives per-run (drawingML a:rPr/@lang) — a textbox has no language of its own. add/set is a convenience that writes the FIRST run's rPr; read it back at run scope (/shape[N]/paragraph[P]/run[R]). Not surfaced at shape level (first-run projection is lossy and a new run would not inherit it).

name: headingFont
description: major (heading) Latin typeface.

name: bodyFont
description: minor (body) Latin typeface.

name: headingFont.ea
description: major (heading) East Asian typeface (CJK).

name: headingFont.cs
description: major (heading) Complex Script typeface (Arabic/Hebrew/Thai).

name: bodyFont.ea
description: minor (body) East Asian typeface (CJK).

name: bodyFont.cs
description: minor (body) Complex Script typeface (Arabic/Hebrew/Thai).

name: dk1
description: dark 1 — default text color in the theme color scheme.

name: lt1
description: light 1 — default background color in the theme color scheme.

name: dk2
description: dark 2 — secondary dark / dark accent color in the theme color scheme.

name: lt2
description: light 2 — secondary light / light accent color in the theme color scheme.

name: accent1
description: theme accent color 1.

name: accent2
description: theme accent color 2.

name: accent3
description: theme accent color 3.

name: accent4
description: theme accent color 4.

name: accent5
description: theme accent color 5.

name: accent6
description: theme accent color 6.

name: hyperlink
description: theme hyperlink color.

name: followedhyperlink
description: theme followed (visited) hyperlink color.

name: name
description: theme color scheme name (e.g. 'Office'). Set persists clrScheme/@name across reopen.

name: transition
description: transition type token, optionally combined with direction/speed/duration via 'TYPE-DIR-SPEED' or 'TYPE-DIR-DUR' (e.g. push-right-1500, split-vertical-in, fade-slow). 'none' removes the transition.

name: advanceTime
description: auto-advance after time (ms, or 'none' to clear)

name: advanceClick
description: advance on click (schema default true; attribute is stripped when set to true)

name: transitionDuration
description: transition duration in milliseconds (CT_TransitionStartSoundAction @dur on PowerPoint 2010+ extLst transition). Set indirectly via the combined transition shorthand: `transition=TYPE[-DIR]-DUR_MS` (e.g. `transition=push-right-1500`).

name: transitionSpeed
description: legacy transition speed token (CT_SlideTransition @spd) — fast/med/slow. Set indirectly via the combined transition shorthand: `transition=TYPE[-DIR]-SPEED` (e.g. `transition=fade-slow`).

name: target
description: target slide number (1-based). Required. Alias: slide.

name: x
description: length in cm (e.g. "2cm")

name: y
description: length in cm (e.g. "2cm")

name: width
description: length in cm (e.g. "2cm")

name: height
description: length in cm (e.g. "2cm")

name: name
description: zoom frame name. Defaults to 'Slide Zoom N'.

name: returnToParent
description: return to parent slide after zoom plays.

name: transitionDur
description: transition duration in ms. Defaults to 1000.
